thread:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick kickoff thread for cloud storefront staging. Goal: coordinate AWS/GCP/Azure staging artifacts, legal checklist, SKU copy, and creative by next Tue. Short answers please so we can run a preflight.
Dev (Cloud Ops): I can stand up sandboxes and the example IAM roles. Need the preferred role names and account IDs to finish.
Jin (Product): SKU rules are: one SKU per cloud, 14-day trial, trial converts to paid unless canceled. We'll keep pricing mapping simple: Starter / Scale / Enterprise. I can draft the SKU table.
Asha (Legal): For legal we need: publisher agreement link or signed doc, privacy policy URL, export control confirmation, and a logo release form. I'll assemble a checklist and share.
listing-bot: Staging scaffolds created: AWS acct 444555666777 (role Redwood_Market_Installer), GCP project redwood-staging-2024, Azure subscription staging-44. Uploads: https://internal.example/staging/444555666777
Design (Creative): Can do hero 1200x628 and two short demo gifs. ETA for drafts?
Maya (Partnerships): Owners/ETAs: Dev -> sandboxes + ARNs (today 6pm). Jin -> SKU copy + one-liner + pricing mapping (tomorrow noon). Asha -> legal checklist + signoff flow (tomorrow EOD). Design -> hero + gifs (Wed EOD). I'll run the preflight next Thu 9am.
Dev (Cloud Ops): Pushed IAM snippets to repo. Recommend webhook auth via HMAC header (X-RW-Sig) and a rotateable shared secret. I'll post ARN + creation steps by 6pm.
Jin (Product): Draft name: "Redwood Inference: Cloud Starter". One-liner idea: "Managed, low-latency LLM inference with cost controls and SLA options." Will post SKU table in the doc.
Asha (Legal): Name OK. Legal contact: legal+marketplace@redwood.com. I will include privacy blurb: "We do not retain prompt text; telemetry excludes PII."
Design (Creative): Quick Q: do we want animated UI gifs or simple demo flow? Animated UI is higher fidelity but takes longer.
Maya (Partnerships): Animated if possible; otherwise screen-record quick flows. Prioritize clarity over polish.
Dev (Cloud Ops): Note for AWS role: trust policy must allow sts:AssumeRole from marketplace principal. Example trust snippet in ops repo: ```{\n  "Version":"2012-10-17",\n  "Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::444555666777:role/MarketplaceInstaller"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]\n}```
Jin (Product): Also adding UX note: trial starts on first API call, show remaining days via /account endpoint.
Asha (Legal): I'll add export control checkbox to the onboarding form and confirm whether we need SOC/AUP mention (probably optional for staging).
listing-bot: Legal template v4 uploaded to /shared/legal/marketplace/v4.pdf
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks. If anyone hits a blocker, drop it here and ping me. I'll share the preflight checklist link shortly.
Dev (Cloud Ops): Small ops ask: enable cross-account CloudWatch forwarding to our central logs for staging so we can debug listing verification.
Asha (Legal): Fine with that as long as logs exclude prompt text. Please redact PII at source.
Jin (Product): Will add a note to backend to scrub prompt_text before any outbound telemetry.
Design (Creative): Got it. I'll upload initial hero + two GIF options by Wed.
Maya (Partnerships): Great. Preflight Thu 9am unless we finish earlier. :calendar:
